name: Silumgar
description: Silumgar is a cruel, venomous, snake-headed dragonlord of Tarkir, one of its five elder dragons, who ruled the Sultai.

description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

summary.text: Silumgar is a cruel, venomous, snake-headed dragonlord of Tarkir, one of its five elder dragons, who ruled the Sultai.

bio.text: Over millennia Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan, and Silumgar led the swamp dragons.

timeline.summary: Khan Reyhan is killed when Ojutai, Silumgar and their broods attack the meeting of khans, leaving Daghatar's people under Dromoka as survivors.
timeline.quote: Ojutai , Silumgar and their broods attacked the meeting, killing her

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur offends the rakshasa and makes a pact with Silumgar, who inherits their pacts.
timeline.quote: Tasigur made a pact with Silumgar

citation.text: "Demon", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the other khans' meeting place to Silumgar's brood.
timeline.quote: Tasigur betrayed the other khans by revealing the location of their meeting

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon Broods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai begin raiding the Ukud Necropolis vaults.
timeline.quote: After the Stormnexus Ritual and Silumgar's disappearance, the Sultai began raiding its vaults.

citation.text: "Gudul delta", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kotis leads a resistance from Kishla, briefly independent from Silumgar until reinforcements push rebels into the jungle.
timeline.quote: the village was briefly independent from Silumgar

citation.text: "Gudul delta", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun summons the khans to Dirgur Stronghold, but Tasigur has betrayed them to the dragon broods; the Jeskai are subjugated and Shu Yun murdered.
timeline.quote: The ensuing battle ended with the utter subjugation of the Jeskai, the murder of Shu Yun

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the original timeline Silumgar dies in the river Marang, killed by a young Sultai khan.
timeline.quote: Silumgar never reached elder status and died in the river Marang

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Original timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur makes a deal with Silumgar's brood, leading them to attack the Khan meeting.
timeline.quote: Tasigur was forced to make a deal with Silumgar 's brood, leading them to attack the Khan meeting that took place several years later.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sultai are utterly enslaved by the dragons, ending their identity as an independent clan.
timeline.quote: the Sultai were utterly enslaved by the dragons, ending their identity as an independent Clan

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur is rewarded for betraying the khans by becoming Silumgar's slave and trophy of war.
timeline.quote: After betraying the other khans to the dragons, Tasigur was rewarded for this by becoming Silumgar's slave, his trophy of war.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the khans' meeting at Dirgur stronghold; Reyhan is killed and Shu Yun and the Ghostfire initiates give their lives.
timeline.quote: Tasigur betrays the location to the dragonlords.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Khanfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Over millennia, Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan.
timeline.quote: Over the millennia, the spirit dragon Ugin's magic coalesced into powerful storms on his native plane of Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: In the new timeline, Silumgar forces the naga into slavery as a result of Tasigur's pact; after his overthrow the Sultai revive.
timeline.quote: Naga were forced into becoming slaves, undead or otherwise, by Silumgar as the result of a pact Tasigur made with the dragon.

citation.text: "Naga", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tasigur stands barefoot on the Marang riverbank and offers the dragon Silumgar his jade throne, kneeling in terror as the dragon descends.
timeline.quote: Six of his soldiers came forward, carrying the throne he had forsaken.

citation.work: The Doom of the Golden Fang
citation.text: "The Doom of the Golden Fang" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Bells announce Silumgar's brood and Ojutai's brood, which merge and fly together toward Dirgur.
timeline.quote: Out over the water, the two massive flights of dragons raced toward each other, crashed together…and merged

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun takes the Annals scrolls from Quan to hide them and leaps from the window onto Silumgar's dragon, killing it with his tattooed palm.
timeline.quote: His dragon tattoo flashed with magical energy, and he slammed his palm into a very particular spot on the dragon's skull.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Reyhan is killed by Silumgar while holding off dragons as Yasova and Alesha escape across the lake.
timeline.quote: Reyhan was felled by Silumgar himself.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Silumgar sleeps on Tasigur's throne while Shidiqi and zombies collar Tasigur and make him the dragon's trophy.
timeline.quote: After all, Tasigur," she said, "you are his finest trophy.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The Khanfall: each khan falls and their clans with them; five dragon clans rise under the dragonlords.
timeline.quote: one by one, each of the ancient humanoid khans fell, and their clans fell with them

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Silumgar's dragonlord discovers Sidisi's manipulation of translations and has her executed.
timeline.quote: when he discovered her manipulation, the paranoid dragonlord had her executed

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Silumgar has Sidisi raised as an intelligent undead servant.
timeline.quote: so he had her raised as an intelligent undead servant, one he could more closely control

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sidisi rallies the naga and gains the allegiance of many sibsig, though she remains loyal to Silumgar for now.
timeline.quote: Sidisi has been able to rally the naga and gain the allegiance of a large number of sibsig zombies

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan saves Ugin in Tarkir's past, changing the future so that the Sultai no longer exist and Silumgar and his clan supplant them.
timeline.quote: When Sarkhan saved Ugin in Tarkir's past, it changed Tarkir's future.

citation.text: Fate Forgotten (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A party of Atarka warriors mistakes Sorin for a Silumgar death-spawn and threatens to take his head.
timeline.quote: Your head will decorate a spear tonight.

citation.text: "Sorin's Restoration" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: After Tasigur offends the Rakshasa and Nagas, the Sultai make a pact with Silumgar.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the other khans and is made Silumgar's pet, displayed as a pendant.

citation.text: "Silumgar", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sultai subjects foment resistance against Silumgar, supported by dissident naga necromancy.

citation.text: "Sultai Brood", section "Revival of the Sultai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Silumgar weakened and Teval's aid, the rebels defeat the dragonlord and take power.
timeline.quote: they fought and defeated the dragonlord, installing themselves in power

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the khans' meeting place to Silumgar and becomes his pet.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed by Oret; Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.
timeline.quote: Sidisi is killed and resurrected as a sibsig vizier to Silumgar.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Dragons of Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sidisi confronts the envoy about the short tribute and warns that he must speak to her, not to the dragon.
timeline.quote: Do you not believe that your Lord deserves his cut?

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: The envoy throws a vial at Silumgar, who is unharmed, and Silumgar's poison breath engulfs the room.
timeline.quote: It sailed across the room and struck Silumgar's massive body.

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sidisi reveals she keeps a collection of poisons in the hole where her heart was, waiting for the day to take back power and make the naga rulers.
timeline.quote: On that day, she would take the power the dragon had stolen from her, and the naga would become what they were always meant to be—rulers of these lands.

citation.text: "The Poisoned Heart" by Sam Stoddard. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Tasigur seeks out the dragon Silumgar and offers his allegiance for the dragon's help.
timeline.quote: his allegiance for the dragon's assistance.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Dragons assault Dirgur Stronghold, Tasigur betrays the khans, Shu Yun offers his life to Ojutai, and Reyhan dies helping Yasova and Alesha escape; the clans fall.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ikra Shidiqi betrays the Sultai khan Tasigur to the dragonlord Silumgar and becomes his dragonspeaker.

citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Patrons from different clans quarrel over which rebellion leader was the real hero, while illusions of the dragonlords roar out of the smoke.
